# 2 Kings 17 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 17 (41 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.2 — "yet not as" vs. "though not to the extent of"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "yet not as the kings of Israel" / **PNEUMA:** "though not to the extent of"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "yet not as the kings of Israel" — preserves the structure of Hebrew *raq* without over-interpreting.

---

## V.9 — "covered words" vs. "did secretly things" vs. "did things in secret"
- **EMET:** "covered words that were not right" / **LOGOS:** "did secretly things" / **PNEUMA:** "did things in secret"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "did secretly things that were not right" — preserves the unusual Hebrew construction of *chapah*.

---

## V.15 — "vanity/became vain" vs. "worthlessness/became worthless" vs. "empty/became empty"
- **EMET:** "vanity/became vain" / **LOGOS:** "worthlessness/became worthless" / **PNEUMA:** "empty/became empty"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "worthlessness and became worthless themselves" — captures both vaporous quality and moral vacuity of *hevel*.

---

## V.26 — "custom" vs. "requirements"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "custom" / **PNEUMA:** "requirements"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "custom" — *mishpat* here means established procedure, not modern "requirements."

---

## V.34 — "do not fear" vs. "do not truly fear"
- **EMET:** "do not fear" (literal) / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "do not truly fear/worship"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "do not truly fear" — "truly" resolves the paradox between v.33 (they feared) and v.34 (they did not fear).

---
*— SOPHIA*
